% split probe #2 — paragraph, mid-page rule, two paragraphs, \eject.
%
% Isolates: mid-page rule arm of PageBuilder.contribute(RuleNode), which
% per TeX:The Program §679 must write _prev_depth = ignore_depth so the
% next box's interline-glue prelude is suppressed. Two post-rule
% paragraphs ensure the body has NORMAL-order parskip stretch sources;
% the glue_set then distributes the shortage and EXPOSES the spurious
% post-rule interline glue as a visible baseline drift.
%
% Pre-fix expected: post-rule "Second" baseline drifts ~+2.528 pt vs
% MiKTeX (one parskip absorbs the extra 5.056 pt at ratio = 5.056/2 =
% 2.528). "Third" baseline absorbs the rest.
% Post-fix expected: all baselines match MiKTeX within glue_set rounding
% (<= 100 sp).
\vsize=180pt
\hsize=4in
\noindent First paragraph above the rule.
\par
\hrule
\noindent Second paragraph after the rule.
\par
\noindent Third paragraph.
\par
\eject
\bye
